why: This is a snapshot taxonomy for selecting educator-used generative AI tools, not a general theory of how people learn or a method for studying learning.
This is a narrow hypothesis about why laboratory cognitive tests may fail to predict everyday performance, not a general theory of learning or teaching.
This is a study-specific two-dimensional coding framework for analyzing students' electronics use, not a general explanatory theory of learning.
name: Two-dimensional framework for classifying electronics use in research labs
